name: A Lonely Shrine
source:
In a shrine, a goddess nearing the end of her life is kept alive only by the visits of a simple cat. She begins to reflect on her long life and the state of the world outside her shrine. As she is forced to ponder her own mortality, she becomes increasingly remorseful about her end and agitated towards those who brought it upon her.

[From [url=https://tanoneko.itch.io/a-lonely-shrine]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一座神社里，一位生命将尽的女神，仅靠一只普通猫咪的探访维系着存在。她开始回顾自己漫长的一生，思考神社之外的世界。当她被迫正视自己的终结时，便越发悔恨，也越发怨恨那些将这一切带给她的人。

[摘自[url=https://tanoneko.itch.io/a-lonely-shrine]Itch.io[/url]]
